questions.prompt: The new room is ______ than the old room.
questions.explanation: 比较两者用比较级 bigger，than 前用比较级。
questions.evidence: The quiet room is smaller than the old reading room, but it is quieter.

questions.prompt: This map is ______ than the paper list.
questions.explanation: 多音节形容词 helpful 的比较级用 more helpful。
questions.evidence: The map is more helpful than the old paper list.

questions.prompt: There ______ 25 computers in the library today.
questions.explanation: today 表示现在，25 computers 是复数，用 there are。
before 表示过去，40 spaces 是复数，用 there were。
is 后接现在分词 rising，表示正在上升。
questions.evidence: The number of visitors continues to rise.

questions.prompt: The library has ______ shelves than before.
questions.explanation: shelves 是可数名词复数，比较级用 fewer。
questions.evidence: The new design has fewer shelves and more open space.

questions.prompt: The children's area is ______ than before.
questions.explanation: 单音节形容词 large 的比较级是 larger。
questions.evidence: The children's area is larger than before.

questions.prompt: There ______ a small café in the library now.
questions.explanation: a small café 是单数，现在时用 there is。
questions.evidence: The library also added a small café.

title: The Library's New Map: Comparing Old and New Access · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
本课学习四种表达。第一，比较结构：用 -er/more + than 比较两者，如 smaller than, more helpful than。第二，百分比与数量：50 percent increase 表示增长百分之五十；数字前用 about 表示大约。第三，there was / there were：there was 后接单数名词，there were 后接复数名词，如 There were 10 computers before. 第四，趋势动词：rise（上升）、grow（增长）、increase（增加）描述变化。注意：there was/were 是复习，比较结构是本课新重点。

There were 10 computers before.
